title: Motion (Hernandez for Padilla – Price) relative to renewing licenses for licensees that would have been eligible to participate in the City's Cannabis Tax…
text:
[Council File 26-1321]
Motion (Hernandez for Padilla – Price) relative to renewing licenses for licensees that would have been eligible to participate in the City's Cannabis Tax Amnesty Program for calendar year 2027, submitting timely and complete applications, and paying all renewal fees regardless of their current tax delinquency status.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Renewing licenses for licensees eligible to participate in the City's Cannabis Tax Amnesty Program for calendar year 2027.

outcome.text: Public Works Committee approved as amended (Sep 22, 2026)
